{{Top|leg}}
{{Citation}}
'''Murglaks''' were a species of creatures often considered disgusting and revolting by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community. "Murglak" or "[[son of a murglak]]" were often used as insults.

{{Creature-stub}}
